entries.54974052228b31fd: This reportable segment manufactures and sells engine compressors, engine generators, aerial work platforms and others, and is the larger of the 2 reportable segments by net sales to external customers. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥44,552 million (up 1.0% year on year), and segment profit was ¥7,043 million (up 11.9%); both were record highs. The securities report gives the breakdown of net sales as domestic construction machinery ¥19,626 million (down 3.6%) and overseas construction machinery ¥24,925 million (up 4.8%). In Japan, engine generators grew on demand from wide-area rental companies, while shipments of engine compressors were sluggish as construction plans stalled due to labor shortages and soaring raw material prices. Overseas, shipments of engine compressors to North America grew significantly and engine generators recovered, offsetting weakness in Asia, including China, according to the securities report. The company, Ienu Shisutemu Co., Ltd., Fandorī Co., Ltd., AIRMAN USA CORPORATION and affiliate Shanghai Fukusei Airman Kiden Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell the products, and Ēesushī Co., Ltd., HOKUETSU INDUSTRIES EUROPE B.V. and AIRMAN ASIA SDN.BHD. handle sales.
entries.5a8a4524880970a7: This reportable segment manufactures and sells motor compressors, emergency generators and others. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥11,052 million (up 8.1%), and segment profit was ¥2,221 million (up 22.3%); both were record highs. The securities report says that while domestic capital investment sentiment remained solid, OEM supply of motor compressors to Kobelco Compressors Corporation contributed to results, and sales of compressor bodies sold externally, manually operated aerial work platforms, and parts and services also increased. On the profit side, the company cites the pass-through of motor compressor price increases and an increase in higher-margin products sold externally. The company and Fandorī Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell the products, and Ēesushī Co., Ltd. handles sales. In December 2025, the company launched generators for refrigerated and frozen containers (reefer containers) and aims to newly enter the cold chain industry.
